paper_title: Short-range spin-dependent interactions of electrons: a probe for exotic pseudo-Goldstone bosons
coupling_convention: (g_p^e)^2/(hbar c), dimensionless squared pseudoscalar electron coupling, exactly as plotted on y-axis
notes: Torsion-pendulum/rotating-attractor experiment probing spin-dependent (pseudo-Goldstone/axion-like) forces between electrons. Primary dipole-dipole result: (g_p^e)^2/hbar c < 5.5e-17 (2 sigma) for m_b < 30 ueV, weakening up to m_b <= 500 ueV. Values emitted are the electron pseudoscalar coupling SQUARED as plotted on Fig.4 y-axis; take sqrt (~7.4e-9) to obtain g_ae. Paper ALSO reports CP-violating monopole-dipole limits |g_p^e g_s^N|/hbar c (MonopoleDipole type) improving prior bounds by up to 1000x for 1.5-400 ueV (Fig.5, ~1e-28 level) — a second distinct result not encoded here. Coupling-type ambiguity between AxionElectron (dipole-dipole) and MonopoleDipole lowers confidence.
